name: speckit-plan

# speckit-plan

Use after a spec is stable enough to plan.

## Instructions

1. Read `.specify/templates/commands/plan.md`, the constitution, the plan template, and the feature spec.
2. Build a Constitution Check for every principle.
3. Show only affected paths.
4. Define technical direction, risks, and validation.
5. Write to `.specify/specs/NNN-feature/plan.md`.
